messages:
Sam: thinking out loud — proposed a 'multi-spot lattice' autoscaler for inference fleets. idea: maintain multiple heterogeneous spot pools with staggered scale-out triggers and per-pool cooldown jitter so we avoid synchronized surges that spike eviction risk. anyone object?
Anya: sounds interesting. main worry is correlated evictions across AZs/providers. how do you detect a 'storm' vs normal churn?
Kevin: +1. we should surface an "eviction momentum" signal: moving-window eviction rate normalized by pool size. if momentum > threshold, throttle scale-outs and favor warm-standby lanes.
Sam: exactly. rough formula i sketched: 
```
eviction_momentum = (evictions_last_5m / pool_instances) * decay_factor(5m)
if eviction_momentum > 0.02 -> apply backoff multiplier to scale_out_rate
```
Anya: love the momentum idea. also add an inertia term so a single minute spike doesn't immediately lock us down.
lina: another piece — network egress hotspots in region X spike during scaleouts. if multiple pools are colocated we amplify that. plan to spread pool primaries across placement groups.
raj: cost note — split pools by instance family + pricing band. we should prefer cheaper families when utilization < 40%, but degrade to lower-cost families only when p95 latency stays under SLO. so autoscaler needs a cost-aware candidate ranking.
Kevin: agreed. propose local scoring function per pool: score = alpha*latency_headroom + beta*(1 - price_rank) - gamma*eviction_momentum. rank highest to scale first.
Sam: here's a draft of a config snippet for the new autoscaler (pseudoyaml):
```yaml
pools:
  - name: A100-spot-eu
    families: [a100, a2]
    priority: 10
    scale_out_threshold: 0.65 # queue utilization
    cooldown_s: 180
    cooldown_jitter_s: 30
    warm_standby: 2
  - name: v100-spot-odd
    families: [v100, t4]
    priority: 6
    scale_out_threshold: 0.7
    cooldown_s: 240
    cooldown_jitter_s: 60
    warm_standby: 1
surge_control:
  global_max_scale_per_min: 8
  per_pool_soft_limit: 4
  per_pool_hard_limit: 6
backoff_policy:
  base_multiplier: 1.0
  eviction_momentum_threshold: 0.015
  max_multiplier: 0.1
```
Anya: config looks good. question: what metric triggers the immediate fallback to on-demand/dedicated? i think two conditions combined: eviction_momentum > X for 10m OR global failed-allocs rate > Y.
Sam: agreed. fallback rule: if (eviction_momentum > 0.02 for 10m) OR (alloc_fail_rate > 0.05 for 5m) -> spin up warm-dedicated until stability returns.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] rolling canary of autoscaler v0.6 -> staging started by Sam (23:12) :rocket:
Kevin: we should also implement a soft token bucket for surge actions so we don't immediately consume burst capacity. tokens replenish at baseline_rate and cost_budget reduces token refill if spend projected > monthly cap.
lina: note on networking: when warm-standby instances join, they hit our model pull CDN. add a randomized delay + local cache priming to avoid surge of model downloads.
raj: cost calc quick check: warm-standby baseline of 2 per pool increases monthly bill ~ +3% but saves ~ 30% of on-demand fallbacks in experiments. ok tradeoff if SLOs matter.
Anya: actionables:
- Sam: add eviction_momentum metric to prometheus + grafana panel (due EOD)
- Kevin: prototype token-bucket surge governor in scaler (PR)
- lina: add model-pull jitter + cache priming hooks to image bootstrap
- raj: run cost sensitivity sim for warm-standby counts (next 48h)
Sam: assigning in thread. i'll push the staging config and attach the canary to a small subset of inference jobs. will monitor p95 latency, eviction_momentum, alloc_fail_rate. :eyes:
Kevin: small nit — expose per-pool recent evictions in the console and surface a 'heat' label so oncall can triage quickly.
Anya: +1. create alert: "spot-pool-eviction-momentum > 0.02 for 10m" -> page infra-oncall. keep severity P2 unless combined with alloc_fail_rate.
ops-bot: [alert] created: spot-pool-eviction-momentum > 0.02 for 10m -> infra-oncall (P2)
Sam: thanks all. will report back after the canary run (give it 4h).
lina: good plan, gl with canary :thumbsup:
raj: will share cost sim results once ready.
Kevin: merging initial PR to staging branch now.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] canary rollout complete to 3 hosts (staging) by Sam (23:47)
Sam: canary looks healthy so far — p95 stable, no large evictions. continuing watch.
